integrity: Analytical all-period proof and explicit finite-level quadrature argument; separate exact-rational finite checks. Originality is limited to inspected evidence and not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Fixed deterministic disturbance and positive integer slopes at least two; all-period theorem does not extend to noninteger slopes or random-in-time forcing. Discontinuous Borel couplings permitted. Uniform exponent sharp, full three-coordinate constant not established.
title: Coupling-independent periodic grids and sharp equidistribution in triangular modular maps
